title: Concept: Locked package hosted over cleartext
description: pubspec.lock declares a hosted description URL over cleartext, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: An artifact fetched over plain HTTP can be replaced in transit, so the bytes that install are not bound to what the author published. This rule reads a hosted description URL over cleartext.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through pubspec.lock (pub).
risk: An artifact fetched over plain HTTP can be replaced in transit, so the bytes that install are not bound to what the author published. This rule reads a hosted description URL over cleartext.
